core_reference.citation: Gu, Kelly, Xiu (2020) Empirical Asset Pricing via Machine Learning, Review of Financial Studies 33(5)
core_reference.use: Tree-ensemble (XGBoost/RF) + Neural Net dominates linear in cross-section. Walk-forward expanding window + purged CV mandatory.

core_reference.citation: Lopez de Prado (2018) Advances in Financial Machine Learning
core_reference.use: Purged k-fold + embargo window + ensemble averaging to control selection bias.

core_reference.citation: Avramov, Cheng, Metzker (2023) Machine Learning vs Economic Restrictions: Evidence from Stock Return Predictability, Management Science
core_reference.use: ML alpha decays under liquidity/short-sale restrictions — KR long-only top20 retains usable predictability via ensemble + cross-family features.

core_reference.citation: Lewellen (2015) The Cross-Section of Expected Stock Returns, Critical Finance Review
core_reference.use: Cross-sectional combination of multiple anomalies (FF5 + momentum + quality) outperforms single signals — supports adding KR FF5 v2 monthly factor returns as features.

core_reference.citation: Barroso, Santa-Clara (2015) Momentum has its moments, JFE 116(1)
core_reference.use: Risk-managed momentum / regime-conditional adjustment robust — basis for using regime indicator as ML feature.
